layers.title: Mars 2020 Perseverance traverse waypoints
layers.resolution: Irregular point records at rover drive endpoints; no fixed raster resolution
layers.license_or_credit: Credit NASA/JPL. Verify dataset-specific attribution/terms before redistribution.
layers.confidence: High for source waypoint records; app route and safety outputs are derived estimates
layers.measured_or_derived: Mission waypoint fields are source records; route comparisons, interpolated terrain corrections and reachability surfaces are derived by the application

layers.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic, Jezero Crater
layers.resolution: Approximately 20 m/pixel native; app output sampled to approximately 215 m per cell
layers.license_or_credit: USGS metadata marks product public domain and requests author citation. Cite Fred Calef / USGS Astrogeology Science Center (2021), Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic.
layers.confidence: Dataset product is documented by USGS; model interpretation is limited by resampling and terrain assumptions
layers.measured_or_derived: DEM elevation raster is source data; 261x261 JSON grid is resampled by the included processor
layers.coordinate_reference: Mars equirectangular; planetocentric latitude; positive-east longitude; radius 3,396,160 m
layers.processing: Direct Mars planetary-coordinate sampling to 261x261 app grid; no terrestrial EPSG:4326 transform; native ~20 m pixels resampled to ~215 m cells

layers.title: HiRISE Jezero local digital terrain models
layers.resolution: Product-dependent; some DTM products have metre-scale sampling
layers.license_or_credit: Follow the selected USGS/PDS product metadata and cite the individual product team.
layers.confidence: Product dependent; requires local source-label and projection verification
layers.measured_or_derived: Source DTM elevations are measured/derived product values; WALKBACK patch preview is a separately sampled local extract and does not affect the global solver

layers.title: THEMIS controlled visual mosaic (qualitative only)
layers.resolution: Product-dependent; controlled global infrared mosaics commonly ~100 m/pixel
layers.license_or_credit: Credit NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University/USGS as specified by the selected product metadata.
layers.confidence: Visual context only for 8-bit controlled mosaics; not a temperature or dose layer
layers.measured_or_derived: Input imagery is source imagery; WALKBACK percentile-stretches it to grayscale solely for display
layers.projection_note: Do not assume the CTX coordinate convention. Verify the exact THEMIS/PDS map label (including aerocentric/planetocentric latitude and positive-east convention), explicitly warp to the app-compatible Mars equirectangular metre grid, then run the processor.

embedded_waypoints.method: SHA-256 over JSON.stringify of embedded WP array in index.html; checked by scripts/validate_embedded_data.mjs
